name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box, feet shoulder-width apart, a comfortable distance away.
Swing your arms back and dip into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, swinging your arms and jumping onto the box with both feet.
Land softly in a squat position with your whole foot on the box.
Stand tall, then step back down one foot at a time.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A plyometric jump onto a box that builds lower-body power and coordination.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

commonMistakes: Jumping off the box and landing hard
Using a box that is too tall
safetyNotes: Choose a box height you can land on comfortably; avoid on bad knees or ankles and never jump onto an unstable surface.
